NYT samples from Freedom Forum, collected November 20, 2026. The dated HA cache
provided Nov 15–20; the live Nov 19–20 sources were also checked. Fixtures are
350 px wide, except the Nov 20 spread (700 px) to preserve its footer barcode.

- `nyt-20261115.jpg`: 700 x 1342 original, no bottom ad.
- `nyt-20261116.jpg`: 700 x 1342 original, full-width theater ad below the footer.
- `nyt-20261117.jpg`: 700 x 1342 original, no bottom ad.
- `nyt-20261118.jpg`: 700 x 1342 original, no bottom ad.
- `nyt-20261119-normal.jpg`: https://cdn.freedomforum.org/dfp/jpg19/lg/NY_NYT.jpg (original 700 x 1342).
- `nyt-20261120-ad-spread.jpg`: https://cdn.freedomforum.org/dfp/jpg20/lg/NY_NYT.jpg (original 700 x 671).

Source slots follow `https://cdn.freedomforum.org/dfp/jpg<day>/lg/NY_NYT.jpg`
and roll over each month. Nov 19 has no bottom ad; Nov 20 has Tiffany ads on the
left and below the footer. Tests also vary the real Nov 16 band's height and
retain ambiguous bands without a barcode or with a caption below them.
